Fork metadata

@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 is the MIT-licensed Hopding/fontkit fork of foliojs/fontkit.
The npm package names Andrew Dillon as author and Devon Govett as contributor.
The fork package has no separate LICENSE file; its package.json and README both
state MIT. The original fontkit MIT notice above is preserved from foliojs/fontkit.
Bundled dependency notices are preserved separately in fontkit-NOTICES.txt.
